notes: URD Rewards: actual MORPHO claimed on the legacy (pre-Merkl) Universal Rewards Distributors, aggregated per day.

Merkl Campaigns: DAO-only Merkl campaigns (creatorTag=morpho) across all chains, distributed per-day from each campaign's amount over its active duration. Excludes third-party MORPHO campaigns routed through the same Merkl infrastructure.

URD Rewards.methodology: Actual MORPHO incentives claimed from the legacy (pre-Merkl) Universal Rewards Distributors.

urd-claims.name: URD Claims
urd-claims.methodology: Tracks MORPHO claimed on the legacy URD contracts, aggregated per day. These distributors are disjoint from the Merkl distributor, so URD claims and Merkl campaigns never double-count the same tokens.

Merkl Campaigns.methodology: Actual MORPHO incentives distributed through DAO-only Merkl campaigns across all chains.

merkl-campaigns.name: Merkl Campaigns
merkl-campaigns.methodology: Tracks DAO-only Merkl campaigns (creatorTag=morpho), distributed per-day from each campaign's amount over its active duration. Excludes third-party MORPHO campaigns routed through the same Merkl infrastructure.
